dtparam=audio=on
dtparam=krnbt=on
dtparam=uart1=on

# CPU
arm_boost=1

[all]
# Keep start_x=1: the _x pair (start4x.elf/fixup4x.dat) is what the bootloader
# image ships, and it is the firmware build that carries the VideoCore codecs
# used by /dev/video11. start_x=0 would select start4.elf, which is absent.
start_x=1
enable_uart=1
uart_2ndstage=1
arm_64bit=1
enable_gic=1
kernel=u-boot.bin
armstub=bl31.bin
# Headless: no camera module, don't probe/load camera overlays
camera_auto_detect=0

dtoverlay=dwc2
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d

max_framebuffers=2

# Automatically load overlays for detected DSI displays
display_auto_detect=1

# Headless: no scanout buffers to reserve. 256 MB still covers the vc-sm-cma
# (bcm2835-codec) buffers for 1088x832..1920x1080 H.264/MJPEG plus v3d.
dtoverlay=cma,cma-256
dtoverlay=rpivid-v4l2

# USB
dtoverlay=dwc2,dr_mode=peripheral
[cm4]
dtoverlay=dwc2,dr_mode=host
[all]

# Fan
dtoverlay=gpio-fan,gpiopin=18,temp=55000

# CM4 external Wi-Fi antenna
dtparam=ant2

# I2C for argonfan
dtparam=i2c1=on
dtparam=i2c_arm=on

# RPI 4 headless boot fix
hdmi_force_hotplug=1 

# Force performance governor during boot
initial_turbo=60

# RTC
dtoverlay=i2c-rtc,ds3231

# Moderate OC Profile
#over_voltage=5
#arm_freq=1800
#gpu_freq=600
#core_freq=550
#v3d_freq=600
#h264_freq=550
